Idea.title: Idea
Idea.description: User authored idea with AI research, action plan, and marketplace query items

userId.description: The UID of the user who created the idea

category.description: Category such as Business, Creative Projects, Personal Goals or custom

tags.description: List of hashtags attached to the idea

isPublic.description: Whether the idea is visible to other community users for discussion

collaborators.description: List of collaborator names or user IDs

aiResearchSummary.description: AI research overview and feasibility breakdown

aiActionPlan.description: Step-by-step action plan milestones generated by AI

aiMarketplaceKeywords.description: Items and equipment keywords to hunt on Facebook Marketplace

aiMarketplaceItems.description: JSON/text write-up of equipment recommendations, prices, and inspection tips

Comment.title: Comment
Comment.description: Discussion and feedback comment on an idea

ideaId.description: The ID of the parent idea

/ideas/{ideaId}.description: Collection of user ideas with AI research and marketplace data

/ideas/{ideaId}/comments/{commentId}.description: Comments and collaborative feedback for an idea
